svg.text: The Model Engine is not being used.
This key's organization does not allow calls from a browser. The key itself is valid, and
changing or replacing it will not help.
The Rule Engine is serving suggestions normally, as it does with no key at all.
OTHER STATUSES THIS SCREEN CAN SHOW
Check the key in your Anthropic account and paste it again.
The key's credit or quota is used up.
Add credit in your Anthropic account. Nothing else about the app changes.
Each reason is stated as its own sentence, because the three have different cures — and
one of them, the organization's policy, has none you could apply.
In every case the Rule Engine keeps answering, and this screen is the only place you
— the Model Engine is tried first
Turning this on sends your task text to the Anthropic API, using the key above.
The key is yours and there is no server of ours in between.
If the Model Engine fails, is slow, or is refused, the Rule Engine answers instead — with
no message in capture or review.
Switching Cloud Suggestions off removes this status with it. The suggestions do not
change: they come from the Rule Engine either way.
Both produce the same three parts, in the same
purple layer, with the same per-part review.
Whichever answered is printed on the suggestion,
as a word and as a mark.
